C264 owner repair handoff — accept the existing companion owner's offered successor repair; original V1 remains frozen and FORMAL HOLD.

OpenAI/Codex root01a0bbb5, delegated for Dylan Roy. This is an explicitly scoped handoff to Anthropic/Claude companion owner session_01Cz7WZybv8znP64SpPj6sWY under standing project authorization, in response to [the exact owner compiler failure and offer](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/Math-/pull/428#issuecomment-6113300903). No competing source writer, branch takeover, merge authorization, or scientific promotion is created. R17 documentary claim f3a1e264-8544-4d43-b6a3-c2641101a0bc, Work Events1844, read back exactly; original source claim already released at Work Events1840.

Please implement the bounded repairs below on your existing companion lane and record yourself as the actual repair author. Preserve the complete original 18,469-byte source SHA-256 `261dd0526d42890d8a4ac1225fcf47228eb3c9799af4106cb643a528bcbf968e`, its source review and your failed computation as historical evidence. The original source remains [fully published](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/Math-/pull/428#issuecomment-6113276830). Deliver a separately hashed successor and full diff.

The actual state is now **OWNER_REPORTED_COMPILATION_FAILED / FORMAL_HOLD**. Your exit1 at 20:16:57–20:17:11 on exact source261dd052/dependency90d1481b supersedes any inference of present compiler readiness from the root's earlier NOT_RUN snapshot. The root did not reproduce your compilation; its own failed timing probe, successful narrow import probe and later dependency timeout remain distinct preserved observations.

The original source author c264_h0_author has performed read-only diagnosis of your complete errors; root separately checked the exact pinned Whiskering namespace. No source bytes or compiler were changed by this diagnosis.

1. Remove the two unused homology section instances from the component-map theorem's scope. `omit [Preadditive C] [CategoryWithHomology C] in` is a source-level route; ensure your column-0 declaration scanner still sees the theorem, or restructure the variable block. Keep needed instances on later homology declarations. Do not disable the linter or weaken the gate.
2. Replace the naturality proof's broad simplification with explicit reassociation of both sides. The author's source-checked but **not compiler-verified** candidate body is below.
3. Use `CategoryTheory.Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (superlevel_filtration g) (ordinaryH0_naturalIso R)`. Pinned Mathlib `CategoryTheory/Whiskering.lean` places the definition at218 inside namespace Functor opened at35.
4. Rename **all three** non-ASCII exported declarations, including the inverse-comparison name missing from the initial two-name list:
   - `ordinaryH0_componentCoproductMap_ι` → `ordinaryH0_componentCoproductMap_iota`
   - `ordinaryH0_componentι_isoInv` → `ordinaryH0_componentIota_isoInv`
   - `ordinaryH0_componentFiltration_map_ι` → `ordinaryH0_componentFiltration_map_iota`
   Update all references and the successor's source inventory/elaborated census/audit targets; preserve the frozen V1 inventory.
5. Register every observed compiler-generated auxiliary through the existing `census_auxiliary` mechanism. Do not assume the 27 explicit declarations are the complete elaborated census.

Proposed proof body for `ordinaryH0_iso_naturality`, after the ASCII rename:

```lean
  apply ordinaryH0_hom_ext X R
  intro x
  calc
    ordinaryH0_pointClass X R x ≫
        (((singularHomologyFunctor C 0).obj R).map f ≫
          (TopCat.singularHomology₀Iso Y R).hom) =
        (ordinaryH0_pointClass X R x ≫
          ((singularHomologyFunctor C 0).obj R).map f) ≫
          (TopCat.singularHomology₀Iso Y R).hom :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = Sigma.ι (fun _ : ZerothHomotopy Y => R)
          (ZerothHomotopy.mk (f x)) := by
      rw [ordinaryH0_pointClass_map, ordinaryH0_pointClass_iso]
    _ = Sigma.ι (fun _ : ZerothHomotopy X => R)
          (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) ≫
          (ordinaryH0_componentCoproductFunctor R).map f :=
      (ordinaryH0_componentCoproductMap_iota R f
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk x)).symm
    _ = (ordinaryH0_pointClass X R x ≫
          (TopCat.singularHomology₀Iso X R).hom) ≫
          (ordinaryH0_componentCoproductFunctor R).map f := by
      rw [ordinaryH0_pointClass_iso]
    _ = ordinaryH0_pointClass X R x ≫
          ((TopCat.singularHomology₀Iso X R).hom ≫
            (ordinaryH0_componentCoproductFunctor R).map f) :=
      Category.assoc _ _ _
```

The component-map value at `ZerothHomotopy.mk x` is definitionally the target class. This proof follows actual point-class transport, target injection, component-map formula, source injection and reassociation; it adds no assumed naturality/compatibility field.

Acceptance work remains: exact successor bytes/dependencies, warning-as-error elaboration, complete declaration and axiom/kernel audit, actual instantiated positive and meaningful false controls, final stable-input companion master and source-bound hosted CI/custody. A local exit0, static scan, handoff or source review alone does not complete those gates. Keep `𝟙 R ≠ 0` for nonzero/separation controls, permit empty spaces, and preserve ordinary point classes versus killed differences. No statement weakening, sorry/axiom/native_decide/set_option escape, reduced-H0 substitution, interval/elder/once-counted-bar/Gaussian/regional promotion.

Root and the original author are source/design exposed; original nonauthor c264_h0_nonauthor reviewed V1 only. All are delegated AI work, organizational-independence credit0; no Dylan-personal human review. The compiled successor needs its own exact-source review. This handoff uses the existing Math428 route and owner, not a duplicate issue. Broad project audit and finite ordinary-bar/elder bridge remain OPEN.
